title: Calendar scheduling week view
description: A week grid for booking or arranging time: days as columns, time as rows, existing events as blocks, free slots selectable, time zone shown explicitly, and an alternative list of available slots for users who cannot use the grid. Handles overlapping events and all-day items.
intent: Let users see availability over a week and book or move time reliably, including across time zones.
characteristics: day columns with time rows at 15-30 minute granularity
explicit time zone label and switcher
overlapping events laid out side by side
all-day row separate from the time grid
interaction: Click or keyboard-select a free slot to start booking; drag to move or resize only as an enhancement with a form-based alternative; Today, previous, and next week controls; current time line.
responsive: Below tablet width switch to a single-day view with day tabs or to the slot list; never a seven-column grid on a phone.
accessibility: Slots and events have accessible names with full date, time, and time zone; drag operations have keyboard and form alternatives (WCAG 2.5.7); color-coded calendars also carry text labels.
limitations: Recurring events and daylight-saving transitions need careful date logic, not covered here.
Grid keyboard navigation is complex; the slot list is the dependable path.
